#define SIMD128_EXTRACT_LANE(name, suffix)                                    \
  case IrOpcode::k##name##ExtractLane##suffix:                                \
    return __ Simd128ExtractLane(Map<Simd128>(node->InputAt(0)),              \
                                 Simd128ExtractLaneOp::Kind::k##name##suffix, \
                                 OpParameter<int32_t>(node->op()));
